name: 98328 · Eatonville, WA
findings: ZIP 98328 (Eatonville) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98328 (Eatonville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98328 (Eatonville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).
